using namespace std;

class HZSShufflesCards {
public:
    long long modInv(long long n) {
        long long m = 998244353;
        long long x = 0, y = 1;
        long long r = n, g = m;
        while (r != 0) {
            long long q = g / r;
            g %= r;
            long long temp = g;
            g = r;
            r = temp;
            x -= q * y;
            temp = x;
            x = y;
            y = temp;
        }
        assert(g == 1);
        assert(y == m || y == -m);
        return (y % m + m) % m;
    }

    long long ncr(long long n, long long r) {
        long long m = 998244353;
        long long fact = 1;
        long long invFact = 1;
        for (long long i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            fact = (fact * i) % m;
            if (i <= r) {
                invFact = (invFact * modInv(i)) % m;
            }
        }
        return (fact * modInv(r)) % m * modInv(n - r) % m;
    }

    long long mult(long long p, long long q, long long r) {
        long long m = 998244353;
        return (p * q) % m * r % m;
    }

    long long add(long long a, long long b) {
        long long m = 998244353;
        return (a + b) % m;
    }

    long long subtract(long long a, long long b) {
        long long m = 998244353;
        return (a - b + m) % m;
    }

    long long phaseSize(long long n, long long m) {
        long long p = 1;
        for (long long i = 0; p != 0; i++) {
            p = mult(p, n - i, modInv(n + m - i));
        }
        return p;
    }

    long long solve(long long n, long long m) {
        long long phase = phaseSize(n, m);
        long long answer = 0;
        for (long long k = 1; k <= n; k++) {
            long long numPhases = mult(m + k, modInv(k));
            long long term = mult(ncr(n, k), numPhases, phase);
            if ((k & 1) == 1) {
                answer = add(answer, term);
            } else {
                answer = subtract(answer, term);
            }
        }
        return answer;
    }
};

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    HZSShufflesCards solver;
    long long n, m;
    cin >> n >> m;
    cout << solver.solve(n, m) << endl;

    return 0;
}
